newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Tellus shares close sharply up.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Tellus shares close sharply up.

text.p: Foreign currency B shares of Shenzhen Tellus Machinery & Electronics Co Ltd surged 10 percent to its daily limit up by close of business on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
The counter rose HK$0.33 to close at HK$3.64 on volume of 1.3 million shares.
Analysts said talk in the market that the company would announce good 1996 annual results pulled the share price up.
"Investors are buying on talk that the company has turned losses to profit for 1996," an analyst at Sun Hung Kai Investment Services Ltd in Shenzhen said.
